summary: Coeur d'Alene NF lookout near Kellogg: a 30-foot pole tower with an L-6 cab, built 1934 and destroyed 1955. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-6 cab on a 30-foot pole tower, with a cabin for living quarters
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1955; no source describes what remains at the site

events.note: 30-foot pole tower with L-6 cab, built with a cabin for living quarters
Destroyed; the sources give no cause

evidence.supports: 30-foot pole L-6 tower with log cabin living quarters, built 1934
evidence.quote: This 30' pole L-6 tower, along with log cabin living quarters, built in 1934

evidence.supports: cabin built along with the tower
evidence.quote: built along with cabin living quarters

evidence.supports: L-6 is an 8 by 8 foot pre-cut frame house, smaller than the L-4
evidence.quote: The L-6 is an 8 x 8 foot frame pre-cut lookout house, an even smaller version of the L-4.

evidence.supports: L-6 cab built atop tall wooden towers
evidence.quote: It was built atop tall wooden towers

sources.title: Lookout Styles, Nez Perce National Forest

notes_for_editor: The 1934 and 1955 dates agree across firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Lookouts page (which cites Kresek). The 1934 built event is new; the 1955 destroyed event was already in the record. No source says what remains, who staffed it or how it was destroyed. The 'hike-in' tag is from Idaho Fire Lookouts and the trail was not checked. The L-6 size comes from a Nez Perce National Forest style note, not a Coeur d'Alene source. The story is short because the record is thin.
